title: Opus Viral on X
tagline: One shape, never cut: a button morphs through 13 UI states on a 120 BPM loop, driven by a real cursor.
description: Dribbble-level UI motion. A single black-and-white shape morphs — size, radius and colour on springs — from a button into a loader, a check, a dynamic island, a music player you play and scrub, a volume slider that stretches past max, a toggle that flips on the beat, a liquid tab indicator, a chart that draws itself with a hover tooltip, a ⌘K palette you type into, and a toast — then back to the button, so the last frame is the first. 7 bars at 120 BPM with something on every beat, a camera that zooms so each state fills the square, and true sub-frame motion blur in renders.
author: Insyd
